candidate_timeline.outro_summary: Richie returns expecting his old reputation to buy authority. Tony turns the poker dispute into a financial penalty. The jacket becomes another attempt to recover status, then ends up on somebody else. Richie can argue about the rules. Tony still gets to enforce them.
